```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

input_dir <- dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE))
report_dir <- if (file.exists(file.path(input_dir, "NMA network structure analysis.Rproj"))) {
  input_dir
} else {
  normalizePath(file.path(input_dir, ".."), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
}
empirical_result_dir <- file.path(report_dir, "Empirical data", "results")
null_result_dir <- file.path(report_dir, "Simulated data", "results")
result_dir <- file.path(report_dir, "Report 3 - Network metric comparisons", "results")
dir.create(result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# This report intentionally sources no simulation or metric-computation file.
# It only reads results produced by empirical_database.Rmd and
# null_model_sample.Rmd.
required_files <- c(
  empirical_metrics = file.path(empirical_result_dir, "empirical_metrics.rds"),
  empirical_degrees = file.path(empirical_result_dir, "empirical_degrees.rds"),
  empirical_edge_multiplicity = file.path(
    empirical_result_dir, "empirical_edge_multiplicity.rds"
  ),
  empirical_trial_fit = file.path(empirical_result_dir, "empirical_trial_geometric_fit.rds"),
  null_metrics = file.path(null_result_dir, "null_metrics.rds"),
  null_degrees = file.path(null_result_dir, "null_degrees.rds"),
  null_edge_multiplicity = file.path(
    null_result_dir, "null_edge_multiplicity.rds"
  ),
  null_trial_fit = file.path(null_result_dir, "null_trial_geometric_fit.rds"),
  fitted_lines = file.path(null_result_dir, "fitted_line_parameters.rds")
)
missing_files <- required_files[!file.exists(required_files)]
if (length(missing_files) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Run empirical_database.Rmd and null_model_sample.Rmd first. Missing: ",
    paste(missing_files, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

empirical_metrics <- readRDS(required_files[["empirical_metrics"]])
empirical_degrees <- readRDS(required_files[["empirical_degrees"]])
empirical_edge_multiplicity <- readRDS(
  required_files[["empirical_edge_multiplicity"]]
)
empirical_trial_fit <- readRDS(required_files[["empirical_trial_fit"]])
null_metrics <- readRDS(required_files[["null_metrics"]])
null_degrees <- readRDS(required_files[["null_degrees"]])
null_edge_multiplicity <- readRDS(required_files[["null_edge_multiplicity"]])
null_trial_fit <- readRDS(required_files[["null_trial_fit"]])
fitted_line_parameters <- readRDS(required_files[["fitted_lines"]])

empirical_legend_label <- "Empirical"
simulated_legend_label <- "Simulated"
comparison_labels <- c(
  "Null Model" = simulated_legend_label,
  "Database" = empirical_legend_label
)
comparison_colors <- c("Null Model" = "grey60", "Database" = "#0072B2")
degree_fit_colors <- c("Null Model" = "grey10", "Database" = "#0049f2")
comparison_data <- bind_rows(
  null_metrics |> mutate(Data = "Null Model"),
  empirical_metrics |> mutate(Data = "Database")
) |>
  mutate(Data = factor(Data, levels = names(comparison_colors)))

required_mean_degree_columns <- c(
  "mean_bipartite_trial_degree",
  "mean_bipartite_treatment_degree",
  "mean_unipartite_weighted_degree",
  "bi_trial_deg_irreg",
  "bi_treatment_deg_irreg"
)
missing_mean_degree_columns <- setdiff(
  required_mean_degree_columns, names(comparison_data)
)
if (length(missing_mean_degree_columns) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Run empirical_database.Rmd and null_model_sample.Rmd again. Missing ",
    "mean-degree metrics: ", paste(missing_mean_degree_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}
if (!"diameter" %in% names(comparison_data)) {
  stop(
    "Run empirical_database.Rmd and null_model_sample.Rmd again. Missing ",
    "metric: diameter"
  )
}

plot_x_label_size <- 11
plot_y_label_size <- 11
plot_legend_size <- 12
comparison_dot_guide <- guide_legend(
  override.aes = list(shape = 16, size = 4.2, alpha = 1, linetype = 0)
)
comparison_filled_dot_guide <- guide_legend(
  override.aes = list(shape = 21, size = 4.2, alpha = 1,
                      colour = "grey15")
)

plot_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = plot_x_label_size),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = plot_y_label_size),
    legend.title = element_text(size = plot_legend_size, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = plot_legend_size),
    legend.key.width = grid::unit(0.6, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = grid::unit(0.6, "cm"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )
theme_set(plot_theme)

plain_log_labels <- function(x) format(x, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
x_label_unipartite_degree <- "Number of other treatments \n compared to each treatment"
x_label_bipartite_trial_degree <- "Number of arms in the trial"
x_label_bipartite_treatment_degree <- "Number of trials \n including the treatment"

```

# Network-type comparison

```{r network-type-comparison, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
network_type_levels <- c("looped", "star", "tree")
network_type_labels <- c("Looped", "Star", "Non-star tree")

network_type_data <- bind_rows(
  null_metrics |> transmute(type, Data = "Null Model"),
  empirical_metrics |> transmute(type, Data = "Database")
) |>
  mutate(
    Data = factor(Data, levels = names(comparison_colors)),
    type = factor(type, levels = network_type_levels, labels = network_type_labels)
  ) |>
  count(Data, type, name = "Networks", .drop = FALSE)

knitr::kable(
  network_type_data,
  align = c("l", "l", "r"),
  caption = "Network types in the empirical database and null model"
)

p_network_types <- ggplot(
  network_type_data,
  aes(x = type, y = Networks, fill = Data, colour = Data, alpha = Data)
) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.68) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = comparison_colors, labels = comparison_labels, name = "Data"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = comparison_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_alpha_manual(
    values = c("Null Model" = 0.9, "Database" = 0.7),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(x = "Network type", y = "Number of networks") +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
p_network_types

```

# Degree-distribution comparison

The layout follows the all-degree-distribution figure in `soft_config_model.Rmd`. Panel (b) shows separate maximum-likelihood shifted-geometric fits for the empirical database and null model. Panels (a) and (c) contain no fitted lines.

```{r degree-distribution-comparison, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
degree_comparison <- function(empirical_counts, null_counts) {
  bind_rows(
    null_counts |> mutate(Data = "Null Model"),
    empirical_counts |> mutate(Data = "Database")
  ) |>
    filter(is.finite(degree), is.finite(count), degree > 0, count > 0) |>
    mutate(Data = factor(Data, levels = names(comparison_colors)))
}

degree_unipartite <- degree_comparison(
  empirical_degrees$counts$unipartite,
  null_degrees$counts$unipartite
)
degree_trial <- degree_comparison(
  empirical_degrees$counts$trial,
  null_degrees$counts$trial
) |>
  filter(degree >= 2)
degree_treatment <- degree_comparison(
  empirical_degrees$counts$treatment,
  null_degrees$counts$treatment
)

degree_point_distribution <- function(data, x_label, y_label, title) {
  ggplot(
    data,
    aes(x = degree, y = count, colour = Data)
  ) +
    geom_point(size = 1.8) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = comparison_colors, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10(labels = plain_log_labels) +
    labs(title = title, x = x_label, y = y_label)
}

p_degree_unipartite <- degree_point_distribution(
  degree_unipartite,
  x_label_unipartite_degree,
  "Number of treatments",
  "(a)"
)

trial_degree_levels <- seq.int(
  min(degree_trial$degree), max(degree_trial$degree)
)
degree_trial_bars <- degree_trial |>
  mutate(degree_factor = factor(degree, levels = trial_degree_levels))
trial_geometric_lines <- bind_rows(
  null_trial_fit$line |> mutate(Data = "Null Model"),
  empirical_trial_fit$line |> mutate(Data = "Database")
) |>
  filter(is.finite(count), count >= 1) |>
  mutate(degree_factor = factor(degree, levels = trial_degree_levels)) |>
  filter(!is.na(degree_factor)) |>
  mutate(Data = factor(Data, levels = names(comparison_colors)))

p_degree_trial <- ggplot(
  degree_trial_bars,
  aes(x = degree_factor, y = count, fill = Data, colour = Data, alpha = Data)
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8, preserve = "single"),
    width = 0.72
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(colour = Data),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8, preserve = "single"),
    alpha = 1, size = 2
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = filter(trial_geometric_lines, Data == "Null Model"),
    aes(x = degree_factor, y = count, group = Data),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = degree_fit_colors[["Null Model"]],
    linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = filter(trial_geometric_lines, Data == "Database"),
    aes(x = degree_factor, y = count, group = Data),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = degree_fit_colors[["Database"]],
    linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = comparison_colors, labels = comparison_labels, name = "Data"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = degree_fit_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_alpha_manual(
    values = c("Null Model" = 0.9, "Database" = 0.7),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = plain_log_labels) +
  labs(
    title = "(b)", x = x_label_bipartite_trial_degree,
    y = "Number of trials"
  )

p_degree_treatment <- degree_point_distribution(
  degree_treatment,
  x_label_bipartite_treatment_degree,
  "Number of treatments",
  "(c)"
)

geometric_fit_key <- ggplot() +
  annotate(
    "rect", xmin = 0, xmax = 1.1, ymin = 0, ymax = 1,
    fill = "white", colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.45
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text", x = 0.5, y = 0.82, label = "Geometric Fit",
    fontface = "bold", size = 3.2
  ) +
  annotate(
    "segment", x = 0.08, xend = 0.28, y = 0.53, yend = 0.53,
    colour = degree_fit_colors[["Database"]],
    linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text", x = 0.34, y = 0.53,
    label = sprintf("'%s:'~theta==%.2f", empirical_legend_label,
                    empirical_trial_fit$theta),
    parse = TRUE, hjust = 0, size = 2.7
  ) +
  annotate(
    "segment", x = 0.08, xend = 0.28, y = 0.25, yend = 0.25,
    colour = degree_fit_colors[["Null Model"]],
    linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text", x = 0.34, y = 0.25,
    label = sprintf("'%s:'~theta==%.2f", simulated_legend_label,
                    null_trial_fit$theta),
    parse = TRUE, hjust = 0, size = 2.7
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1), clip = "off") +
  theme_void()

p_degree_trial <- p_degree_trial + inset_element(
  geometric_fit_key,
  left = 0.45, bottom = 0.6, right = 0.99, top = 0.99,
  align_to = "panel"
)

p_degree_comparison <- p_degree_unipartite + p_degree_trial + p_degree_treatment +
  plot_layout(nrow = 1, guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
p_degree_comparison

```

# Edge multiplicity

The multiplicity of an edge is the number of trials in which the same pair of treatments is compared. Each unordered pair is counted once per network. Panel (b) shows the distribution of the total number of edges per network; each dataset contributes one value for each of its 300 networks.

```{r edge-multiplicity, fig.width=11, fig.height=4}
required_edge_multiplicity_columns <- c("network_id", "multi", "count")
for (edge_data_name in c(
  "empirical_edge_multiplicity", "null_edge_multiplicity"
)) {
  missing_edge_columns <- setdiff(
    required_edge_multiplicity_columns,
    names(get(edge_data_name))
  )
  if (length(missing_edge_columns) > 0L) {
    stop(
      edge_data_name, " is missing: ",
      paste(missing_edge_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
}

edge_multiplicity_comparison <- bind_rows(
  null_edge_multiplicity |>
    transmute(multi, count, Data = "Null Model"),
  empirical_edge_multiplicity |>
    transmute(multi, count, Data = "Database")
) |>
  filter(
    is.finite(multi), is.finite(count),
    multi >= 1, count > 0
  ) |>
  group_by(Data, multi) |>
  summarise(count = sum(count), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(Data = factor(Data, levels = names(comparison_colors)))

p_edge_multiplicity <- ggplot(
  edge_multiplicity_comparison,
  aes(x = multi, y = count, colour = Data)
) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10(labels = plain_log_labels) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = comparison_colors, labels = comparison_labels, name = "Data",
    guide = comparison_dot_guide
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Edge multiplicity",
    y = "Number of unipartite edges"
  )

edge_counts_per_network <- bind_rows(
  null_edge_multiplicity |>
    group_by(network_id) |>
    summarise(number_of_edges = sum(count), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(Data = "Null Model"),
  empirical_edge_multiplicity |>
    group_by(network_id) |>
    summarise(number_of_edges = sum(count), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(Data = "Database")
)

if (any(count(edge_counts_per_network, Data)$n != 300L)) {
  stop("Expected 300 edge-count values for each dataset.")
}

edge_counts_per_network <- edge_counts_per_network |>
  mutate(Data = factor(Data, levels = names(comparison_colors)))

p_edge_count_distribution <- ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(
    data = filter(edge_counts_per_network, Data == "Null Model"),
    aes(x = number_of_edges, fill = Data),
    colour = "grey15", linewidth = 0.25,
    alpha = 0.90,
    binwidth = 10, boundary = 0,
    position = "identity",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_histogram(
    data = filter(edge_counts_per_network, Data == "Database"),
    aes(x = number_of_edges, fill = Data),
    colour = "grey15", linewidth = 0.25,
    alpha = 0.70,
    binwidth = 10, boundary = 0,
    position = "identity",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = comparison_colors, labels = comparison_labels) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of unipartite edges",
    y = "Number of networks"
  )

p_edge_multiplicity_comparison <-
  (p_edge_multiplicity + labs(title = "(a)")) +
  (p_edge_count_distribution + labs(title = "(b)")) +
  plot_layout(nrow = 1, widths = c(1, 1.18), guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

p_edge_multiplicity_comparison


```

## Number of distinct treatment pairs

This standalone version of panel (b) shows the exact number of networks at each observed number of distinct treatment pairs. It is displayed in the report but is not saved as a separate file.

```{r distinct-pair-count-scatter, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
distinct_pair_count_distribution <- edge_counts_per_network |>
  count(Data, number_of_edges, name = "count") |>
  filter(number_of_edges > 0, count > 0)

p_distinct_pair_count <- ggplot(
  distinct_pair_count_distribution,
  aes(x = number_of_edges, y = count, colour = Data)
) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = plain_log_labels) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = plain_log_labels) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = comparison_colors, labels = comparison_labels, name = "Data",
    guide = comparison_dot_guide
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of distinct treatment pairs",
    y = "Number of networks"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

p_distinct_pair_count
```

```{r metric-plot-helpers, include=FALSE}
metric_histogram <- function(metric, label, binwidth, boundary = 0) {
  ggplot() +
    geom_histogram(
      data = filter(comparison_data, Data == "Null Model", is.finite(.data[[metric]])),
      aes(x = .data[[metric]], fill = Data),
      colour = "grey15", linewidth = 0.25,
      alpha = 0.90, binwidth = binwidth, boundary = boundary,
      position = "identity", show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_histogram(
      data = filter(comparison_data, Data == "Database", is.finite(.data[[metric]])),
      aes(x = .data[[metric]], fill = Data),
      colour = "grey15", linewidth = 0.25,
      alpha = 0.70, binwidth = binwidth, boundary = boundary,
      position = "identity", show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = comparison_colors, labels = comparison_labels) +
    labs(x = label, y = "Number of networks")
}

metric_scatter <- function(metric, predictor, metric_label, predictor_label,
                           log_y = FALSE,log_x = TRUE, fitted_line = TRUE) {
  plot_data <- comparison_data |>
    filter(
      is.finite(.data[[metric]]), is.finite(.data[[predictor]]),
      .data[[predictor]] > 0
    )
  if (log_y) plot_data <- plot_data |> filter(.data[[metric]] > 0)

  plot <- ggplot() +
    geom_count(
      data = filter(plot_data, Data == "Null Model"),
      aes(x = .data[[predictor]], y = .data[[metric]], fill = Data,
          size = after_stat(n)),
      shape = 21, colour = "grey15", stroke = 0.35, alpha = 0.90
    ) +
    geom_count(
      data = filter(plot_data, Data == "Database"),
      aes(x = .data[[predictor]], y = .data[[metric]], fill = Data,
          size = after_stat(n)),
      shape = 21, colour = "grey15", stroke = 0.35, alpha = 0.70
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = comparison_colors, labels = comparison_labels, name = "Data",
      guide = comparison_filled_dot_guide
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = comparison_colors, guide = "none") +
    scale_size_area(
      max_size = 8, limits = c(1, 24), breaks = c(1, 5, 10, 15, 20),
      oob = scales::squish, name = "Count"
    ) +
    labs(x = predictor_label, y = metric_label)
  if (fitted_line) {
    plot <- plot +
      geom_smooth(
        data = filter(plot_data, Data == "Null Model"),
        aes(x = .data[[predictor]], y = .data[[metric]], colour = Data),
        method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE,
        alpha = 0.90, show.legend = FALSE
      ) +
      geom_smooth(
        data = filter(plot_data, Data == "Database"),
        aes(x = .data[[predictor]], y = .data[[metric]], colour = Data),
        method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE,
        alpha = 0.70, show.legend = FALSE
      )
  }
  if (log_y) plot <- plot + scale_y_log10()
  if (log_x) plot <- plot + scale_x_log10()
  plot
}

make_metric_figure <- function(metric, label, binwidth, bipartite, log_y,
                               fitted_line = TRUE, histogram_boundary = 0) {
  histogram <- metric_histogram(
    metric, label, binwidth, boundary = histogram_boundary
  ) + labs(title = "(a)")
  versus_N <- metric_scatter(
    metric, "N_treatments", label, "Number of treatments",
    log_y = log_y, fitted_line = fitted_line
  ) + labs(title = "(b)")
  if (!bipartite) {
    return(
      histogram + versus_N + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.18)) &
        theme(legend.position = "right")
    )
  }
  versus_M <- metric_scatter(
    metric, "N_total_trials", label, "Number of trials",
    log_y = log_y, fitted_line = fitted_line
  ) + labs(title = "(c)")
  histogram + versus_N + versus_M +
    plot_layout(nrow = 1, guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

metric_numerics <- function(metric) {
  comparison_data |>
    filter(is.finite(.data[[metric]])) |>
    group_by(Data) |>
    summarise(
      Networks = n(), Minimum = min(.data[[metric]]),
      Mean = mean(.data[[metric]]), Maximum = max(.data[[metric]]),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}
```

```{r clustering-predictor-regressions, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
clustering_predictor_data <- comparison_data |>
  filter(
    is.finite(N_treatments), N_treatments > 0,
    is.finite(unipartite_c)

    mean_unipartite_degree_over_N =
      mean_unipartite_unweighted_degree / N_treatments

fit_clustering_predictor <- function(data, predictor, relationship) {
  data |>
    filter(is.finite(.data[[predictor]])) |>
    group_by(Data) |>
    group_modify(~ {
      fit <- lm(
        reformulate(predictor, response = "unipartite_c"),
        data = .x
      )
      tibble(
        Relationship = relationship,
        Intercept = unname(coef(fit)[["(Intercept)"]]),
        Slope = unname(coef(fit)[[predictor]]),
        `R-squared` = summary(fit)$r.squared
      )
    }) |>
    ungroup()
}

p_clustering_inverse_N <- ggplot(

  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = comparison_colors, labels = comparison_labels, name = "Data",
    guide = comparison_dot_guide

  labs(

    y = "Clustering coefficient (Unipartite)"

  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(

    guide = comparison_dot_guide
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "(a)",
    x = "Mean unipartite degree / number of treatments",
    y = "Clustering coefficient (Unipartite)"
```

```{r bipartite-clustering-all-network-regressions, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
prepare_bipartite_clustering_predictors <- function(data) {
  data |>
    filter(
      is.finite(N_treatments), N_treatments > 0,
      is.finite(N_total_trials), N_total_trials > 0,
      is.finite(bipartite_c)
    ) |>
    mutate(
      mean_trial_degree_over_N =
        mean_bipartite_trial_degree / N_treatments,
      inverse_N = 1 / N_treatments,
      inverse_M = 1 / N_total_trials
    )
}

make_bipartite_clustering_panel <- function(data, predictor, title, x_label) {
  data |>
    filter(is.finite(.data[[predictor]])) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = .data[[predictor]], y = bipartite_c, colour = Data)) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.75) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = comparison_colors, labels = comparison_labels, name = "Data",
      guide = comparison_dot_guide
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = x_label,
      y = "Clustering coefficient (Bipartite)"
    )
}

fit_bipartite_clustering_predictor <- function(
    data, predictor, relationship) {
  data |>
    filter(is.finite(.data[[predictor]])) |>
    group_by(Data) |>
    group_modify(~ {
      fit <- lm(
        reformulate(predictor, response = "bipartite_c"),
        data = .x
      )
      tibble(
        Relationship = relationship,
        Intercept = unname(coef(fit)[["(Intercept)"]]),
        Slope = unname(coef(fit)[[predictor]]),
        `R-squared` = summary(fit)$r.squared
      )
    }) |>
    ungroup()
}

bipartite_clustering_specs <- tribble(
  ~predictor, ~relationship, ~title, ~x_label,
  "mean_trial_degree_over_N", "(a) Bipartite density", "(a)",
  "Bipartite density",
  "inverse_N", "(b) 1 / N", "(b)",
  "1 / number of treatments",
  "inverse_M", "(c) 1 / M", "(c)",
  "1 / number of trials"
)

bipartite_clustering_all_data <-
  prepare_bipartite_clustering_predictors(comparison_data)

bipartite_clustering_all_panels <- lapply(
  seq_len(nrow(bipartite_clustering_specs)),
  function(i) {
    specification <- bipartite_clustering_specs[i, ]
    make_bipartite_clustering_panel(
      bipartite_clustering_all_data,
      specification$predictor,
      specification$title,
      specification$x_label
    )
  }
)

  bipartite_clustering_all_panels,
  ncol = 3,
  guides = "collect"
) & theme(legend.position = "bottom")

bipartite_clustering_all_fits <- bind_rows(lapply(
  seq_len(nrow(bipartite_clustering_specs)),
  function(i) {
    specification <- bipartite_clustering_specs[i, ]
    fit_bipartite_clustering_predictor(
      bipartite_clustering_all_data,
      specification$predictor,
      specification$relationship
    )
  }
)) |>
  mutate(Data = unname(comparison_labels[as.character(Data)])) |>
  select(Relationship, Data, Intercept, Slope, `R-squared`)
```

# Saved comparison data

## Fitted-line parameter table

The original parameter rows are loaded from the results prepared by `null_model_sample.Rmd`. The mean-degree rows are fitted here with the same transformations used by the two mean-degree figures above.

```{r fitted-line-parameter-table, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
mean_degree_fit_specs <- tribble(
  ~Metric, ~Network, ~predictor, ~`X-axis`, ~response, ~`Y-axis`, ~log_y,
  "Degree irregularity", "Unipartite",
  "mean_unipartite_weighted_degree", "Mean weighted degree",
  "deg_irreg", "log10(Degree irregularity (Unipartite))", TRUE,
  "Trial-degree irregularity", "Bipartite",
  "mean_bipartite_trial_degree", "Mean trial degree",
  "bi_trial_deg_irreg", "log10(Trial-degree irregularity (Bipartite))", TRUE,
  "Treatment-degree irregularity", "Bipartite",
  "mean_bipartite_treatment_degree", "Mean treatment degree",
  "bi_treatment_deg_irreg", "log10(Treatment-degree irregularity (Bipartite))", TRUE,
  "Degree assortativity", "Unipartite",
  "mean_unipartite_weighted_degree", "Mean weighted degree",
  "assortativity", "Degree assortativity (Unipartite)", FALSE,
  "Degree assortativity", "Bipartite",
  "mean_bipartite_trial_degree", "Mean trial degree",
  "bi_assortativity", "Bipartite degree assortativity (trial-treatment)", FALSE,
  "Degree assortativity", "Bipartite",
  "mean_bipartite_treatment_degree", "Mean treatment degree",
  "bi_assortativity", "Bipartite degree assortativity (trial-treatment)", FALSE
)

fit_mean_degree_line <- function(specification) {
  model_data <- comparison_data |>
    filter(
      is.finite(.data[[specification$response]]),
      is.finite(.data[[specification$predictor]]),
      .data[[specification$predictor]] > 0
    )
  if (specification$log_y) {
    model_data <- model_data |>
      filter(.data[[specification$response]] > 0)
  }

  model_data |>
    group_by(Data) |>
    group_modify(function(data, key) {
      x_fit <- log10(data[[specification$predictor]])
      y_fit <- if (specification$log_y) {
        log10(data[[specification$response]])
      } else {
        data[[specification$response]]
      }
      model <- lm(y_fit ~ x_fit)
      tibble(
        Metric = specification$Metric,
        Network = specification$Network,
        `X-axis` = specification$`X-axis`,
        `Y-axis` = specification$`Y-axis`,
        Slope = unname(coef(model)[2]),
        Intercept = unname(coef(model)[1]),
        `R-squared` = summary(model)$r.squared
      )
    }) |>
    ungroup()
}

mean_degree_fitted_line_parameters <- bind_rows(lapply(
  seq_len(nrow(mean_degree_fit_specs)),
  function(i) fit_mean_degree_line(mean_degree_fit_specs[i, ])
)) |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Metric, Network, `X-axis`, `Y-axis`),
    names_from = Data,
    values_from = c(Slope, Intercept, `R-squared`),
    names_glue = "{Data} { .value}"
  ) |>
  select(
    Metric, Network, `X-axis`, `Y-axis`,
    `Database Slope`, `Database Intercept`, `Database R-squared`,
    `Null Model Slope`, `Null Model Intercept`, `Null Model R-squared`
  )

bi_irregularity_ratio_fitted_line_parameters <-
  bi_irregularity_ratio_parameters_long |>
  mutate(
    Metric = if_else(
      `Node type` == "Trials",
      "Trial-degree irregularity",
      "Treatment-degree irregularity"
    ),
    Network = "Bipartite",
    `X-axis` = "Treatment-to-trial ratio (N/M)",
    `Y-axis` = if_else(
      `Node type` == "Trials",
      "log10(Trial-degree irregularity (Bipartite))",
      "log10(Treatment-degree irregularity (Bipartite))"
    )
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Metric, Network, `X-axis`, `Y-axis`),
    names_from = Data,
    values_from = c(Slope, Intercept, `R-squared`),
    names_glue = "{Data} { .value}"
  ) |>
  select(
    Metric, Network, `X-axis`, `Y-axis`,
    `Database Slope`, `Database Intercept`, `Database R-squared`,
    `Null Model Slope`, `Null Model Intercept`, `Null Model R-squared`
  )

fitted_line_parameters <- fitted_line_parameters |>
  bind_rows(
    mean_degree_fitted_line_parameters,
    bi_irregularity_ratio_fitted_line_parameters
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Network = factor(Network, levels = c("Unipartite", "Bipartite")),
    `X-axis` = factor(
      `X-axis`,
      levels = c(
        "N", "M", "Treatment-to-trial ratio (N/M)",
        "Mean weighted degree", "Mean trial degree", "Mean treatment degree"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(Metric, Network, `X-axis`)

format_parameter <- function(value) {
  ifelse(is.finite(value), sprintf("%.3f", value), "NA")
}

format_x_axis <- function(value) {
  recode(
    as.character(value),
    N = "log10(N)",
    M = "log10(M)",
    .default = as.character(value)
  )
}

cat(
  '<table class="table table-striped table-condensed">',
  '<caption>Fitted-line parameters by metric, network representation, and axis.</caption>',
  '<thead>',
  '<tr>',
  '<th rowspan="2">Metric</th>',
  '<th rowspan="2">Network</th>',
  '<th rowspan="2">X-axis</th>',
  '<th rowspan="2">Y-axis</th>',
  '<th colspan="3" style="text-align:center">Database</th>',
  '<th colspan="3" style="text-align:center">Null Model</th>',
  '</tr>',
  '<tr>',
  '<th>Slope</th><th>Intercept</th><th>R<sup>2</sup></th>',
  '<th>Slope</th><th>Intercept</th><th>R<sup>2</sup></th>',
  '</tr>',
  '</thead><tbody>',
  sep = "\n"
)

for (metric_i in unique(fitted_line_parameters$Metric)) {
  metric_rows <- fitted_line_parameters |>
    filter(Metric == metric_i)
  metric_first <- TRUE
  for (network_i in c("Unipartite", "Bipartite")) {
    network_rows <- metric_rows |>
      filter(as.character(Network) == network_i)
    if (nrow(network_rows) == 0L) next
    network_first <- TRUE
    for (row_i in seq_len(nrow(network_rows))) {
      row <- network_rows[row_i, ]
      cat("<tr>\n")
      if (metric_first) {
        cat(sprintf(
          '<td rowspan="%d"><strong>%s</strong></td>\n',
          nrow(metric_rows), metric_i
        ))
        metric_first <- FALSE
      }
      if (network_first) {
        cat(sprintf(
          '<td rowspan="%d">%s</td>\n',
          nrow(network_rows), network_i
        ))
        network_first <- FALSE
      }
      cat(sprintf('<td>%s</td>\n', format_x_axis(row$`X-axis`)))
      cat(sprintf('<td>%s</td>\n', row$`Y-axis`))
      cat(sprintf('<td>%s</td>\n', format_parameter(row$`Database Slope`)))
      cat(sprintf('<td>%s</td>\n', format_parameter(row$`Database Intercept`)))
      cat(sprintf('<td>%s</td>\n', format_parameter(row$`Database R-squared`)))
      cat(sprintf('<td>%s</td>\n', format_parameter(row$`Null Model Slope`)))
      cat(sprintf('<td>%s</td>\n', format_parameter(row$`Null Model Intercept`)))
      cat(sprintf('<td>%s</td>\n', format_parameter(row$`Null Model R-squared`)))
      cat("</tr>\n")
    }
  }
}
cat("</tbody></table>\n")
```
